framework_source.scope: kernel_optimizer Python sources and role prompts at worker entry

original_request.goal: Reduce first-token latency for the interactive workload, preserving the full generation workload and the source correctness checks.
notes: Command provenance: python qwen_inference.py --assets /root/autodl-tmp/c3-qwen3-4b-operator-goals/assets/Qwen3-4B/1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c --output /tmp/original-qwen. The command passes no --workloads/--warmup/--repeats/--profile, so defaults apply: repository workloads.json, warmup=2, repeats=5, no profiling.

TTFT completion boundary (qwen_inference.py:16-24,37): sync -> t0; prefill forward + first-token argmax -> explicit torch.cuda.synchronize 'first-token-ready' -> t1; ttft_ms=(t1-t0)/1e6. It is model-execution latency, not a service SLA with queuing or network.

Input construction (qwen_inference.py:55-58): the fixed prompt from workloads.json qwen_inference.prompt is rendered with the chat template (enable_thinking=False, add_generation_prompt=True), encoded without special tokens, repeated/truncated to exactly prompt_tokens=256, and replicated to batch=1 as a CUDA tensor before timing.

Discrete outputs needing exact comparison: greedy generated tokens must equal the reference token sequence (torch.equal at qwen_inference.py:62); per-step last-token logits compared with torch.testing.assert_close at atol=rtol=0.02 (common.py:74-76); negative control must reject +1-corrupted logits (common.py:79-84). Reference tensors are saved as <workload.id>-reference.pt.

The script's reference construction (capture run plus teacher-forced re-run), correctness checks, warmup/repeats, saving and optional profiling are measurement infrastructure outside the repeated unit; the internal 31 cached decode iterations are genuine workload iterations and remain inside adapter.run(). The full generation workload (prefill + all decode steps) is preserved even though the objective only scores the first-token boundary.

Numerical/state policy preserved: Qwen3ForCausalLM pretrained weights in torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation='sdpa', local_files_only, .eval() under torch.inference_mode, KV cache via use_cache, TF32 disabled, float32 matmul precision 'highest', cudnn.benchmark off, seed 20261020 (common.py:34-42).

Single-GPU task on the one leased RTX 4090; no distributed backend and no communication collector fields required. ttft_ms is an ordinary end-to-end evaluator metric, not a diagnostic kernel-time objective.

workloads.json declares a second goal (decode_tokens_per_second, max) for this same interactive row and a separate offline batch=8 row; both are distinct source goals, not constraints on this request.

One measured invocation: One greedy generation call infer(model, inputs, new_tokens=32) on the interactive workload (batch=1, prompt_tokens=256): BF16 SDPA Qwen3-4B prefill over the 256-token GPU-resident prompt (use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1), argmax first token, explicit first-token-ready synchronize, then new_tokens-1=31 KV-cached decode steps with per-step argmax for a fixed total of 32 generated tokens (EOS early stop disabled by the explicit loop). Excludes model loading, tokenization, host input construction/transfer, reference construction (capture and teacher-forced runs), correctness checks, warmup/repeats, reference tensor saving, result writing and profiling.
